name: Work and Social Adjustment Scale
time_window_text: Please indicate how much your current feelings or experiences affect the following areas:

items.text: Because of how I have been feeling lately, my ability to work is impaired. '0' means 'not at all impaired' and '8' means 'very severely impaired to the point I can't work'.
Because of how I have been feeling lately, my home management (cleaning, tidying, shopping, cooking, looking after home or children, paying bills) is impaired.
Because of how I have been feeling lately, my social leisure activities (with other people e.g. parties, bars, clubs, outings, visits, dating, home entertainment) are impaired.
Because of how I have been feeling lately, my private leisure activities (done alone, such as reading, gardening, collecting, sewing, walking alone) are impaired.
Because of how I have been feeling lately, my ability to form and maintain close relationships with others, including those I live with, is impaired.

band_descriptions.low: Your responses suggest a low level of functional impairment over the past two weeks. Most people experience occasional difficulties managing daily tasks, and your responses fall within the typical range.
band_descriptions.moderate: Your responses indicate moderate functional impairment over the past two weeks. Many people find it helpful to monitor this and prioritise strategies to support their routines.
band_descriptions.severe: Your responses suggest severe functional impairment over the past two weeks. This level of disruption is significant, and speaking with your GP or a mental health professional could be a valuable next step.
